@justNow: a time on its own, for something that happened less than a minute ago, in lists of pages and files (like “3 minutes ago” beside it); lowercase in English
@markDone: label of the round check box on an assignment or to-do that isn't done yet
@markNotDone: label of the check box on an assignment or to-do that is done
@dueDate: label and tooltip of the date field for when an assignment is due
@newAssignment: button and menu command that opens the sheet for a new assignment
@newEvent: button and menu command that opens the sheet for a new calendar event
@untitledEvent: the name shown for a calendar event that has no title yet
@dueThisWeek: in the summary under the Home and Assignments titles; {count} is how many open assignments are due in the next 7 days (may be 0)
@overdue: in the summary under the Assignments title, after “… due this week”; {count} is how many open assignments are past their due date

dates.@noDueDate: shown where an assignment's due date would be, when it has none
dates.@todayAt: when an assignment is due, if that's today; {time} is a time of day (3:05 PM)
dates.@tomorrowAt: when an assignment is due, if that's tomorrow; {time} is a time of day (3:05 PM)
dates.@yesterdayAt: when an assignment was due, if that was yesterday; {time} is a time of day (3:05 PM)
dates.@dateAt: when an assignment is due; {date} is a weekday (Friday) or a date (Oct 20), {time} a time of day (3:05 PM)
dates.@range: a span of time; {from} and {to} are dates (Oct 14), times (9:00 AM), or month names (Sep) in the calendar's title
dates.@untilTime: when an event that started on an earlier day ends; {time} is a time of day (5:00 PM)
dates.@allDay: when an event has no time of day: it takes the whole day

repeat.@never: the choice in an event's repeat menu for an event that happens once
repeat.@daily: the choice in an event's repeat menu for an event that happens daily; also shown on its own beside an event's date in the calendar import list
repeat.@weekly: the choice in an event's repeat menu for an event that happens weekly; also shown on its own beside an event's date in the calendar import list
repeat.@monthly: the choice in an event's repeat menu for an event that happens monthly; also shown on its own beside an event's date in the calendar import list

repeats.@never: sentence at the foot of an event's sheet, for an event that doesn't repeat (rarely shown)
repeats.@daily: sentence at the foot of an event's sheet, for an event that happens daily
repeats.@weekly: sentence at the foot of an event's sheet, for an event that happens weekly
repeats.@monthly: sentence at the foot of an event's sheet, for an event that happens monthly

repeatsUntil.@daily: sentence at the foot of an event's sheet; {date} is the last date it repeats on (Mar 3)
repeatsUntil.@weekly: sentence at the foot of an event's sheet; {date} is the last date it repeats on (Mar 3)
repeatsUntil.@monthly: sentence at the foot of an event's sheet; {date} is the last date it repeats on (Mar 3)

@inboxTitle: the title of the page Quick Capture creates for to-dos and notes; written into the person's notes as the page's name

capture.@addedToInbox: message after a to-do was captured into the Inbox page
capture.@noteSaved: message after a note was captured as a page inside the Inbox page
capture.@kindLabel: label (for screen readers) of the choice of what a capture becomes: to-do, note, assignment or event

kind.@todo: Quick Capture choice: the text becomes a to-do (a checkbox item)
kind.@note: Quick Capture choice: the text becomes a note (a page)
kind.@assignment: Quick Capture choice: the text becomes a school assignment
kind.@event: Quick Capture choice: the text becomes a calendar event

placeholder.note: A thought — the first line becomes the title

capture.@eventDateTip: tooltip of the date field when capturing an event
capture.@date: label (for screen readers) of the date field in Quick Capture
capture.@time: label (for screen readers) of the time-of-day field in Quick Capture
capture.@timeTip: tooltip of the time-of-day field in Quick Capture
capture.hint: Press <kbd>{mod}</kbd><kbd>Shift</kbd><kbd>Space</kbd> anywhere to capture without opening the app first.
capture.@hint: under Quick Capture on Home; {mod} is the Command (⌘) or Ctrl key; each <kbd>…</kbd> is drawn as a key, so Shift and Space are the keyboard's key names

course.@newTitle: title of the dialog that adds a school course
course.@add: button that adds the course in the New Course dialog
course.@addChip: small button with a + icon in the Assignments view's row of courses, that adds a course (use a verb if your language needs one: “Add course”)
course.@renameMenu: menu command on a course that asks for a new name
course.@renameTitle: title of the dialog that renames a course
course.@color: heading in a course's menu over the colors to choose from
course.@deleteTitle: title of the dialog that asks before deleting a course

deleteInUse.one: “{name}” will be removed from {count} item. The assignments and events stay.
deleteInUse.other: “{name}” will be removed from {count} items. The assignments and events stay.

course.@deleteInUse: message of the dialog that asks before deleting a course; {name} is the course's name, {count} how many assignments and events are in it
course.@deleteUnused: message of the dialog that asks before deleting a course nothing is in; {name} is the course's name

sessionNotes.title: {title} — {date}
sessionNotes.@title: the title of a new page of notes for one class or event (“Biology lecture — Oct 14”), written into the person's notes; {title} is the event's title, {date} its date
sessionNotes.@untitled: the title of a new page of notes for one class whose event has no title, written into the person's notes; {date} is its date (Oct 14)

notesPage.@forAssignment: the first line written into a new notes page of an assignment; <mention/> is where the link to the assignment goes
notesPage.@fromEvent: the first line written into a new notes page of a calendar event; <mention/> is where the link to the event goes
notesPage.@searchText: text a new notes page of an assignment or event is found by in search (shown in search results until the page is edited); {title} is the item's title

toast.@sessionRemoved: message after one date of a repeating event was deleted; {title} is the event's title, {date} the date (Oct 14)
toast.@untitledSessionRemoved: message after one date of a repeating event with no title was deleted; {date} is the date (Oct 14)
toast.@sessionMoved: message after one date of a repeating event was dragged to another day or time; {title} is the event's title, {date} the date it was on (Oct 14)
toast.@movedToTrash: message after an assignment or event was moved to the Trash; {title} is its title

reminders.@untitledAssignment: title of a reminder notification for an assignment that has no title
reminders.@untitledEvent: title of a reminder notification for a calendar event that has no title
reminders.@dueTomorrow: text of the evening reminder notification for an assignment due the next day
reminders.@dueTomorrowAt: text of the evening reminder notification for an assignment due the next day; {time} is a time of day (3:05 PM)
reminders.@dueToday: text of the morning reminder notification for an assignment due that day
reminders.@dueTodayAt: text of the morning reminder notification for an assignment due that day; {time} is a time of day (3:05 PM)
reminders.@dueInAnHour: text of the reminder notification an hour before an assignment is due; {time} is the time it's due (3:05 PM)
reminders.@startsIn: text of the reminder notification before a calendar event; {time} is when it starts (3:05 PM), {count} how many minutes from now (5, 10, 15 or 30)

greeting.@late: Home's title between midnight and 5 AM, when the person's name isn't known
greeting.@lateName: Home's title between midnight and 5 AM; {name} is the person's first name
greeting.@morning: Home's title before noon, when the person's name isn't known
greeting.@morningName: Home's title before noon; {name} is the person's first name
greeting.@afternoon: Home's title from noon to 6 PM, when the person's name isn't known
greeting.@afternoonName: Home's title from noon to 6 PM; {name} is the person's first name
greeting.@evening: Home's title after 6 PM, when the person's name isn't known
greeting.@eveningName: Home's title after 6 PM; {name} is the person's first name

home.@eventsToday: in the summary under Home's title; {count} is how many calendar events there are today
home.@dueThisWeekOverdue: in the summary under Home's title; {count} is how many open assignments are due within a week, {overdue} how many of those are past their due date (1 or more); the form is picked by {count}, so word the overdue part to fit any number
home.@todos: in the summary under Home's title; {count} is how many to-dos (checkbox items in pages) aren't done
home.@flashcardsToStudy: in the summary under Home's title; {count} is how many flashcards are due for review
home.@freeDay: title of the empty Today section on Home
home.@dueSoon: heading of Home's list of assignments due within a week
home.nothingDueText: Assignments due in the next 7 days show up here.
home.@todosTitle: heading of Home's list of to-dos (checkbox items written in pages)
home.@openTodos: beside the To-dos heading on Home; {count} is how many to-dos aren't done
home.noTodosText: Checkboxes you write in any page collect here.
home.@recentPages: heading of Home's list of the pages edited last
home.noPagesText: Pages you edit show up here.
home.@recentFiles: heading of Home's list of the files added last

assignments.@scopeLabel: label (for screen readers) of the choice between upcoming, all and completed assignments

scope.@upcoming: filter choice: assignments that aren't done yet
scope.@done: filter choice: assignments that are done

group.@overdue: heading of the assignments past their due date
group.@week: heading of the assignments due within the next 7 days (after today and tomorrow)
group.@later: heading of the assignments due more than a week from now
group.@none: heading of the assignments without a due date
group.@done: heading of the assignments that are done

assignments.@allCaughtUp: under the Assignments title when every assignment is done
assignments.@intro: under the Assignments title before any assignment was added
assignments.@search: placeholder of the search field in the Assignments view
assignments.@allCourses: filter chip: assignments of every course
assignments.@noCourse: filter chip: assignments that aren't in a course
assignments.@editCourseTip: tooltip on a course's filter chip
assignments.@addTo: placeholder of the quick-add field when a course is chosen; {course} is the course's name
assignments.@addAssignment: placeholder of the quick-add field at the top of the Assignments view
assignments.@noMatches: title shown when no assignment matches the search
assignments.emptyUpcoming: Nothing left to do here. Enjoy the free time.
assignments.emptyStart: Add homework, essays and exams with their due dates. They show up in your calendar too.

assignment.@points: tooltip on an assignment's grade; {score} is the points earned and {max} the points possible (18.5, 20); word it to fit any number, e.g. “Points: {score} / {max}”
assignment.@inProgress: an assignment's status, shown with a clock icon

priority.@low: an assignment's priority, shown with a flag icon
priority.@medium: an assignment's priority, shown with a flag icon
priority.@high: an assignment's priority, shown with a flag icon

assignment.@hasNotes: shown with a note icon on an assignment that has a notes page

event.@repeatsTip: tooltip on the repeat icon of an event that repeats
event.@openNotes: button on an event that opens its notes page
event.@takeNotes: button on an event that creates and opens a notes page for it

calendar.@modeLabel: label (for screen readers) of the choice between the month and week calendar

mode.@month: choice that shows the calendar a month at a time
mode.@week: choice that shows the calendar a week at a time

calendar.title: {month} <year>{year}</year>
calendar.@title: the calendar's title; {month} is a month's name (October) or two (Sep – Oct), {year} the year (2026); <year>…</year> is drawn lighter
calendar.@events: in the summary under the calendar's title; {count} is how many events there are in the month or week shown
calendar.@assignmentsDue: in the summary under the calendar's title; {count} is how many open assignments are due in the month or week shown
calendar.@today: button that moves the calendar to today's date
calendar.@import: button that imports a calendar file (.ics)
calendar.importTip: Your class schedule from Canvas, Google Calendar or Outlook (.ics)
calendar.@importTip: tooltip of the Import button; Canvas, Google Calendar and Outlook are product names
calendar.firstRunText: In Canvas, Google Calendar or Outlook, export or download the calendar as an .ics file, then import it here. Classes, deadlines and repeats come along.
calendar.@firstRunText: Canvas, Google Calendar and Outlook are product names; .ics is a file type
calendar.@importIcs: button that imports a calendar file; .ics is its file type
calendar.@addClass: button that opens the sheet for a new event (a class)
calendar.@selectedDay: label (for screen readers) of the panel beside the month that lists the chosen day's events
calendar.@addToDay: tooltip of the + button in the day panel
calendar.@due: heading in the day panel over the assignments due that day
calendar.@eventsHeading: heading in the day panel over that day's calendar events
calendar.@fromDatabases: heading in the day panel over database rows whose date is that day
calendar.@pages: heading in the day panel over the pages created or edited that day
calendar.@untitledDatabase: the name shown, beside a row from it, for a database that has no title
calendar.@created: beside a page in the day panel: the page was created that day
calendar.@edited: beside a page in the day panel: the page was edited that day
calendar.@nothingScheduled: title shown in the day panel when nothing happens that day
calendar.emptyDayText: Double-click a day to add an event.
calendar.@newEventShort: small button in an empty day panel that adds an event
calendar.@newAssignmentShort: small button in an empty day panel that adds an assignment due that day
calendar.@monthGrid: label (for screen readers) of the grid of days in the month calendar
calendar.@more: button at the foot of a crowded day in the month calendar, that shows the rest in the day panel; {count} is how many more items there are (2 or more); space is tight
calendar.@allDay: label at the left of the week calendar's row of events that take the whole day; space is tight (about 6 letters); lowercase in English
